ns2:course.label: Physical Chemistry II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of CHEM 442, focusing on thermodynamics, statistical mechanics and kinetics from single molecules to the bulk, in gases and in the condensed phase. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for both CHEM 444 and PHYS 427. Prerequisite: CHEM 442.
